headline: Acme Robotics opens second assembly plant to meet warehouse demand
summary: The new plant doubles annual output of the company's picking arms.

headline: Acme Robotics reports quarterly revenue in line with guidance
summary: Revenue matched the range management gave three months earlier.

headline: Acme Robotics wins multi-year contract from a regional grocery chain
summary: The contract covers automation for twelve distribution centers.

headline: Acme Robotics recalls 1,200 picking arms over a gripper sensor fault
summary: The company expects the recall to cost one quarter of service margin.

headline: Acme Robotics beats third-quarter earnings estimates as recall costs fade
summary: Earnings per share came in above the analyst consensus.

headline: Acme Robotics names new chief financial officer
summary: The incoming CFO previously ran finance at an industrial supplier.

headline: Acme Robotics raises full-year outlook on strong service revenue
summary: Management lifted its revenue forecast for the second time this year.

headline: Helix Biotherapeutics starts Phase 3 trial of its lead arthritis drug
summary: The trial will enroll about 900 patients.

headline: Helix Biotherapeutics reports positive early safety data
summary: No serious side effects were seen in the first patient group.

headline: Helix Biotherapeutics extends cash runway with a new credit facility
summary: The facility funds operations into the following year.

headline: Helix Biotherapeutics Phase 3 trial misses its primary endpoint
summary: The drug did not reduce joint pain more than placebo.

headline: Analysts downgrade Helix Biotherapeutics after trial failure
summary: Several analysts cut their price targets by more than half.

headline: Helix Biotherapeutics announces 30 percent workforce reduction to cut costs
summary: The company will focus on two early-stage programs.

headline: Helix Biotherapeutics explores strategic alternatives, including a sale
summary: The board hired an adviser to review options.

headline: Kryo Cold Chain adds 40 refrigerated trucks to its fleet
summary: The expansion targets growing demand for temperature-controlled food delivery.

headline: Kryo Cold Chain reports steady volumes in pharmaceutical shipping
summary: Shipment volumes were flat compared with the previous quarter.

headline: Kryo Cold Chain fined for temperature logging gaps at one depot
summary: An inspector found missing records for three weeks of shipments.

headline: Kryo Cold Chain renews contract with its largest vaccine distributor
summary: The renewal runs for four more years.

headline: Kryo Cold Chain quarterly profit flat as fuel costs offset price increases
summary: Higher diesel prices absorbed the gain from new contract rates.

headline: Kryo Cold Chain completes acquisition of a regional warehouse operator
summary: The deal adds six cold-storage sites.

headline: Luma Optics unveils faster photonic interconnect chip
summary: The chip moves data between servers at twice the previous speed.

headline: Luma Optics shares slide after a key customer delays orders
summary: The customer pushed deliveries into the next quarter.

headline: Luma Optics revenue jumps 35 percent on data center demand
summary: Sales of interconnect chips drove the increase.

headline: Luma Optics warns of supply constraints for specialty wafers
summary: A single supplier provides most of the wafers the company uses.

headline: Luma Optics announces share buyback program
summary: The board approved repurchases worth about 3 percent of shares outstanding.

headline: Luma Optics cuts guidance as two large customers pause spending
summary: Management lowered its full-year revenue forecast.

headline: Luma Optics to present at an industry technology conference
summary: The chief technology officer will give a product update.

headline: Meridian Pantry Foods raises dividend for the 12th straight year
summary: The quarterly dividend increases by 4 percent.

headline: Meridian Pantry Foods reports stable sales of packaged staples
summary: Volumes were unchanged from the same quarter last year.

headline: Meridian Pantry Foods passes higher grain costs to customers with modest price increases
summary: Prices on cereal and pasta products rise by about 2 percent.

headline: Meridian Pantry Foods quarterly earnings meet analyst expectations
summary: Margins held steady despite higher input costs.

headline: Meridian Pantry Foods expands distribution to two new regions
summary: Its products will reach about 800 more grocery stores.

headline: Meridian Pantry Foods recalls one batch of canned soup as a precaution
summary: The company said the recall affects less than 0.1 percent of annual sales.

headline: Qubit Compute shares fall after dilutive secondary offering
summary: The company sold new shares to fund research, diluting existing holders.

headline: Qubit Compute demonstrates 128-qubit processor in lab test
summary: The test showed lower error rates than the previous generation.

headline: Qubit Compute net loss widens as research spending grows
summary: Operating expenses rose faster than revenue.

headline: Qubit Compute signs pilot agreement with a national laboratory
summary: The pilot gives researchers cloud access to the company's processors.

headline: Short seller report questions Qubit Compute revenue recognition
summary: The report claims some pilot revenue was booked too early.

headline: Qubit Compute responds to short seller report and reaffirms its financial statements
summary: The audit committee said its review found no errors.

headline: Qubit Compute shares rally after cloud partnership announcement
summary: A cloud provider will offer the company's processors to its customers.

headline: Valtara Payments processes record transaction volume in January
summary: Holiday returns and new merchants lifted payment volume.

headline: Valtara Payments launches instant payouts for small merchants
summary: Merchants can now receive funds within minutes instead of days.

headline: Regulator opens investigation into Valtara Payments anti-money-laundering controls
summary: The investigation covers how the company checks new merchants.

headline: Valtara Payments suspends merchant onboarding during regulatory review
summary: Existing merchants are not affected by the pause.

headline: Valtara Payments reports slower growth as merchant onboarding stays paused
summary: Revenue growth slowed to its lowest rate in three years.

headline: Valtara Payments reaches settlement with regulator and resumes onboarding
summary: The company agreed to pay a fine and hire an independent monitor.

headline: Valtara Payments quarterly revenue returns to growth
summary: New merchant sign-ups recovered after onboarding resumed.

headline: Zephyr Wind Power commissions 300 MW offshore array
summary: The array is the company's largest project to date.

headline: Zephyr Wind Power output falls as calm weather lowers generation
summary: Quarterly generation was 14 percent below the long-term average.

headline: Zephyr Wind Power keeps quarterly dividend unchanged
summary: The board held the payout at the same level as last year.

headline: Regulator approves Zephyr Wind Power grid connection fee increase
summary: The higher fee adds a stable stream of regulated revenue.

headline: Zephyr Wind Power delays turbine order after supplier backlog
summary: Two onshore projects will start about six months later than planned.

headline: Zephyr Wind Power signs 15-year power purchase agreement with a data center operator
summary: The agreement fixes the price for most of one wind farm's output.
